description: No credential or login required. Reads the result of a job this connection already started, again, from its job_id. Starts no new job, sends nothing to any institution and spends no usage tokens. Use it when a call timed out while the job kept running (the error's data carries the job_id and a ready result_tool_call), or when a download_url in artifacts[] has expired: every call signs fresh links that work for 15 minutes, and the files themselves are kept for 7 days after the job. If the job is still running it waits up to 60 seconds, then says so - call it again a little later. Give pack_run_id instead of job_id to read a pack result again (a pack result that carries artifacts[] has its pack_run_id); a pack that has not finished is reported as not finished - this tool does not advance it. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane.

job_id.description: The job_id of an earlier call, exactly as returned (job_ followed by 26 characters) - in data.job_id of a timeout error, or in job_id of a result that carries artifacts[]. Give this or pack_run_id, not both.

pack_run_id.description: The pack_run_id of an earlier pack result, exactly as returned (prun_ followed by 26 characters). Give this or job_id, not both.

recovery_receipt.description: For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane.
